en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a street scene in front of a large institutional building identified as a hospital. The building has several stories, dormer windows, and a small dome or tower. A cobblestone boulevard with horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians runs alongside. The caption at the top identifies the location as Boulevard Saint-Lazare and the hospital in Mantes-la-Jolie, France.
